# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged  <sub>[v4 c37 P5](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Over-the-harbor, Seven Gulls region  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose is a tall, broad-shouldered man with good features, including a Roman nose and open gray eyes. For fifteen years, he maintained an extraordinarily long, wavy brown beard reaching nearly to his knees and dense, rippling brown hair hanging down his back. After shaving his beard and trimming his hair, he appeared clean-shaven with handsome features, though his new look initially startled those who knew him.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)_

## Personality

Ambrose possesses an unyielding determination and an obstinate streak characteristic of his family. He is a passionate, unmoderate Grit in politics who holds fast to his vows. Despite his fierce political stance and former eccentric appearance, he is a clever, well-read, and cheerful man who loves singing, dancing, and telling engaging stories.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011)_

## Traits

- Obstinate and resolute  <sub>[v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033)</sub>
- Passionate political partisan  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>
- Clever and well-read  <sub>[v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006)</sub>
- Talented dancer and singer  <sub>[v4 c16 P10](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0010), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing Scotch ballads in an excellent tenor voice  <sub>[v4 c16 P10](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0010)</sub>
- Dancing with great, rhythmic grace  <sub>[v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To see the Liberal (Grit) party return to political power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c35 P7](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0007)</sub>

## History

Fifteen years prior to the Liberal victory, Ambrose swore at a public meeting that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Grit party returned to power. He maintained this oath for a decade and a half, growing an exceptionally long hair and beard. On the night the Liberals finally won the general election, he immediately forced the local barber to give him a haircut and shave before sunrise. Following his transformation, he became engaged to Miss Winifred Tolley, whom he had pursued for twenty years, and agreed to move into her home upon their marriage.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c37 P5](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0005), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Vowed during a heated election campaign fifteen years prior not to shave or trim his hair until the Liberals won power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>
